name: gab-fy2027
title: Philippine FY2027 General Appropriations Bill (House, HB 10858) as flat tables
description: Every appropriation the House bill prints, as filed and on 3rd reading, as flat joinable tables with UACS codes (compatible with BetterGov's NEP/GAA datasets), PSGC places, printed totals for verification, and itemized drill-downs.

sources.title: House of Representatives, Committee Report No. 638 on House Bill No. 10858 (FY2027 General Appropriations Bill): copy A as filed, copy B 3rd reading; CR00638.pdf, SHA-256 3242a248d1436be5d15c2bd81628c1c9691e0b796fc4a58552d063f18177b6b0
BetterGov.ph, NEP 2027 (bettergovph/nep-2027, CC0): agency, program and operating-unit codes
Philippine Statistics Authority, PSGC 2nd Quarter 2026 publication datafile

resources.name: appropriations
resources.title: Appropriations (fact table)
resources.description: One row per appropriation line x stage: the printed amount rows with nothing printed beneath them (leaves). Leaves sum to every printed total (see declared_totals.csv). Never sum this table together with drilldown_items.

fields.name: appropriation_id
fields.description: Stable id of one appropriation line, the same in every stage: hash of UACS agency + the printed hierarchy (normalised) + label + occurrence. Join key across stages and to appropriations_compared.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Budget document the figure comes from: GAB_FILED = House bill HB 10858 as filed (copy A of Committee Report 638, identical to the NEP as submitted); GAB_3R = the House bill on 3rd reading (copy B).

fields.name: fiscal_year
fields.description: Fiscal year of the appropriation (2027).

fields.name: dept_id
fields.description: UACS department code (2 digits), the same as `department` in BetterGov's gaa / nep-2027 datasets. See departments.csv.

fields.name: agency_id
fields.description: UACS department + agency code, "DD-AAA" (BetterGov `department` + `agency`). Matched to NEP 2027 by the agency's exact appropriation. See agencies.csv.

fields.name: dept_printed
fields.description: Department name as printed in the bill (the department this row is printed under in this stage).

fields.name: agency_printed
fields.description: Agency name as printed in the bill's Table of Contents.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Top tier of the agency's program table: General Administration and Support, Support to Operations, Operations, Locally-Funded Projects, Foreign-Assisted Projects.

fields.name: program
fields.description: PROGRAM heading (upper case in the bill), if any.

fields.name: sub_program
fields.description: SUB-PROGRAM heading, if any.

fields.name: pap
fields.description: Activity or project name (the PAP: program/activity/project line).

fields.name: sub_pap
fields.description: Deeper activity levels below `pap`, joined with " > ", if any.

fields.name: funding_source
fields.description: For foreign-assisted projects: Loan Proceeds or GOP Counterpart (Philippine government share). Blank otherwise.

fields.name: region_printed
fields.description: Region heading as printed above this row (blank = no region printed: a national lump sum).

fields.name: region_code
fields.description: 2-digit region code, derived from the printed region name (not its numeral, which the bill misprints at least once). Equal to the PSGC region prefix and to BetterGov's `uacs_reg_id`: 13 NCR, 14 CAR, 01-12 Regions I-XII, 16 Caraga, 17 MIMAROPA, 18 NIR, 19 BARMM. See regions.csv.

fields.name: operating_unit
fields.description: Office the money is released to, as printed (Central Office, Regional Office, DPWH District Engineering Office, DepEd Division, hospital, campus...).

fields.name: sub_unit
fields.description: Units printed below the operating unit (e.g. a school under a DepEd Division), joined with " > ".

fields.name: geo_level
fields.description: Finest place the money can honestly be attributed to: national (no region printed), central_office (agency HQ: printed under NCR but NOT Metro Manila spending - keep off maps), region, province, city, municipality, district (legislative district, DPWH), barangay (drill-downs only).

fields.name: psgc_code
fields.description: PSA PSGC 10-digit code of that place (PSGC 2Q-2026). Region-level rows carry the region code; blank for national and central_office. See localities.csv / regions.csv.

fields.name: province_psgc
fields.description: PSGC code of the province (or independent city) containing the place, for province-level maps.

fields.name: district_id
fields.description: Legislative district id (districts.csv), for DPWH District Engineering Office rows mapped to exactly one district.

fields.name: geo_basis
fields.description: Which rule placed this row (e.g. "DEO map", "office prefix (Division/PENRO/CENRO/PARO)", "place name in office name", "regional office", "no region printed"). Filter on it to keep only placements you trust.

fields.name: drilldown_group_id
fields.description: Links an appropriation to the itemized list the bill prints for it elsewhere (drilldown_items.csv, drilldown_coverage.csv). Blank for most rows.

fields.name: label
fields.description: This row's own printed text.

fields.name: ps
fields.description: Personnel Services, pesos (blank = none printed).

fields.name: mooe
fields.description: Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses, pesos.

fields.name: finex
fields.description: Financial Expenses, pesos.

fields.name: co
fields.description: Capital Outlays, pesos.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Total appropriation of the row, pesos (= ps + mooe + finex + co).

fields.name: prexc_fpap_id
fields.description: UACS PREXC program/activity/project code of the matching NEP 2027 line (BetterGov `prexc_fpap_id`). Join key to BetterGov nep-2027 / gaa.

fields.name: nep_description
fields.description: Activity description of the matching NEP line (BetterGov `dsc`).

fields.name: nep_operunit
fields.description: UACS operating unit code of the matching NEP line (BetterGov `operunit`).

fields.name: nep_operunit_name
fields.description: UACS operating unit name (BetterGov `uacs_oper_dsc`), or "N operating units not itemized in the bill" for residual matches.

fields.name: nep_fund_type
fields.description: Fund of the matching NEP line: regular, loan_proceeds, gop_counterpart, or mixed.

fields.name: nep_match
fields.description: How the row matched NEP 2027: unique (amount signature unique in the agency), disambiguated (by region + names), residual (the bill line sums all NEP units it does not itemize, e.g. DepEd "Division Office - Proper"), none, no_filed_counterpart (GAB_3R line with no GAB_FILED twin: added or relabelled).

fields.name: pdf_page
fields.description: Page of CR00638.pdf the row is printed on (1-based PDF page, not the bill's printed page number).

fields.name: path_printed
fields.description: The printed hierarchy above this row, " > "-joined, exactly as in the bill (for audit).

fields.name: source_row_id
fields.description: Row id in the parser output (pipeline/data), for tracing a value back to its parse.
